units: metres, y-up; position = centre of object's base, in parent space; rotation = degrees XYZ
source: scene_spec.json - Slime Arena / Toxic Works (Level 1 - Part 2 of 3)

interpretation.summary: Part 2 of 3 of level 1: the Toxic Works. The round elevator from the Skyforge Arena comes down through the roof into the slime hall (the loading bay / start: crates, vats, claws). An open gate in the hall's north wall leads into the Works wing, a linear route through unique zones from the map: 2 assembly line (conveyors, robot arms), 3 pipeworks (catwalks between pipe runs and pours), 4 purification hall (row of purifier columns), 5 core chamber (ring round the giant core vat), 6 maintenance shafts (lattice tower, stairs up), 7 processing towers (deck among mixed-height towers), 8 waste conduits (ribbed tunnel walk) and the exit door to part 3. Windows look out on the rest of the factory (non-playable background).
interpretation.scale_basis: No dimensions given. Arena square read as 80 m incl. walls so the 11 m edge platforms and 22 m central deck give third-person combat room; heights from the elevation ratio (fluid -> outer deck ~6 m, central deck ~+1 m, tower ~13 m).
visible: octagonal central deck with the round elevator (ref 1)
grated catwalk bridges to square platforms with crates (ref 1)
slime vats with glowing sections, emblem banners (ref 1, 2)
tank towers, tiered decks, gantries beyond (ref 2)
inferred: scale: hall 112 m square so the ref 1 core keeps its 72 m spacing and gains an outer ring
landings joining the bridges to the wall walkway
window sills at 13 m (above reach from the 7 m walkway)
blast door position (north wall, at the north landing)
zone sizes / heights in metres (map has no scale)
the hall stands in for the loading bay (the elevator arrives there)
stairs instead of moving lifts in the maintenance shafts (no moving platforms yet)
assumptions: the factory beyond the windows is scenery, not playable (keeps the file small)
vats are solid and safe to touch (not hazards)
